free_tier_limits: 1000 requests per month (hard limit on Basic/free plan)
rate_limits: Free: 1000 req/month hard limit. Paid plans raise monthly quota only. HTTP 429 when quota exceeded. Per-request caps: hourly max 30 days; daily max 10 years. No separate per-second limit published.
description: Meteostat's JSON API serves historical hourly, daily, and monthly weather observations plus climate normals from thousands of stations and model-backed point queries. Hosted on RapidAPI, it returns JSON with meta and data objects for station lookup, nearby search, and time-series ranges. Free for light use (1000 calls/month); paid tiers raise monthly quotas. Separate free bulk dumps and a Python library exist outside this API.
